HOME.ABOUT_SUBTITLE: Real, practical and accessible knowledge about fishkeeping.
HOME.ABOUT_P1: Blue Fox Aquarismo is an educational platform created to share real, accessible knowledge about aquariums, fish, aquatic plants and responsible maintenance.
HOME.ABOUT_P2: The project was born from hands-on practice and day-to-day observation, bringing together real experiences, continuous learning and the common situations faced both by people setting up their first aquarium and by experienced fishkeepers.
HOME.ABOUT_P3: Here you will find much more than theory: clear explanations of frequent mistakes, good practices, cycling, species compatibility and the essential care for a healthy aquarium in the long run.
HOME.ABOUT_P4: Besides the written content, the platform offers interactive tools for hands-on learning, helping you plan aquariums, test your knowledge and make safer decisions for the well-being of the fish and the aquatic ecosystem.
HOME.FEATURE1_TEXT: Articles, guides and clear explanations about setup, cycling, species and care.
HOME.FEATURE2_TEXT: Practical resources to learn visually, test your knowledge and plan aquariums.
HOME.FEATURE3_TEXT: Content based on practice, observation and continuous learning in the fishkeeping world.
HOME.TOOLS_TEXT: Learn fishkeeping in a practical, visual and interactive way with tools designed for every level.
HOME.TOOL1_TEXT: Simulate setting up an aquarium considering species, size, filtration and compatibility.
HOME.TOOL2_TEXT: Test your knowledge about species, care and maintenance while you learn.
HOME.TOOL3_TEXT: Light, interactive learning with educational games about fishkeeping.
HOME.COMMUNITY_P1: All content at Blue Fox Aquarismo comes from practice: tests, mistakes, adjustments and day-to-day learning with real aquariums. That is how we build solid, honest and reliable knowledge for fishkeepers of every level.
HOME.COMMUNITY_P2: There are no magic formulas or unrealistic promises here. The focus is on showing what really works, explaining the reasons behind each practice and warning about common problems many fishkeepers face.
HOME.COMMUNITY_P3: The project is always open to dialogue. Suggestions for new content, corrections, improvements or even personal experiences are very welcome. The idea is to keep evolving together with the community.

ABOUT.TITLE: About Blue Fox Aquarismo
ABOUT.LEAD: An educational platform that brings together fishkeeping, technology and responsible knowledge.
ABOUT.HISTORY_P1: Blue Fox Aquarismo was born in late 2025 as a way to combine two passions: fishkeeping and technology. Created by Felipe Ferraz, a fishkeeper for more than 10 years, the platform aims to give back to the community through structured knowledge, practical tools and a clearer, more responsible approach to aquariums.
ABOUT.HISTORY_P2: Over the years there were three different aquariums, with a preference for planted community tanks, where the balance between species, plants and water parameters requires constant observation, study and adjustment. This hands-on experience is the foundation of Blue Fox Aquarismo. The project was not created as just a blog, but as a Digital Educational Platform that brings together technical content, real experience and interactive resources.
ABOUT.WHY_TEXT: Keeping an aquarium means taking responsibility for a living ecosystem. Correct information reduces mistakes, avoids unnecessary losses and promotes more ethical and sustainable practices. Blue Fox Aquarismo exists to organise knowledge, fight misinformation and support informed decisions.
ABOUT.PURPOSE_LEAD: Blue Fox Aquarismo has three main pillars:
ABOUT.PILLAR1_TEXT: Many fishkeepers start with fragmented information or common myths. The goal is to offer clear, accessible and organised explanations for people setting up their first aquarium.
ABOUT.PILLAR2_TEXT: For those already in the hobby, the platform also goes deeper into technical concepts, biology, cycling, species compatibility, filtration and ecosystem balance.
ABOUT.PILLAR3_TEXT: Blue Fox brings programming to fishkeeping through simulators, quizzes and interactive resources that help with decision-making and hands-on learning.
ABOUT.FIND_LEAD: The platform was designed for different levels and approaches:
ABOUT.FIND1_TEXT: Well-founded explanations of biology, water chemistry, species behaviour and ecosystem balance.
ABOUT.FIND2_TEXT: Accounts based on experience, tests, mistakes, adjustments and lessons learned over more than a decade in the hobby.
ABOUT.FIND3_TEXT: Step-by-step guides for setup, cycling and responsible maintenance.
ABOUT.FIND4_TEXT: A critical look at popular practices that are not always correct or sustainable.
ABOUT.FIND5_TEXT: Tools, simulations and gamified resources that make learning more visual and practical.
ABOUT.TRANSPARENCY_P1: Blue Fox Aquarismo is an independent project. All content is based on study and hands-on experience.
ABOUT.TRANSPARENCY_P2: In the future, the platform may include ads or partnerships, always transparently and without compromising the quality or impartiality of the information. The terms of use and the privacy policy are publicly available:
ABOUT.TRANSPARENCY_P3: The main commitment is to clarity, honesty and the well-being of our users.
ABOUT.COMMUNITY_P1: Just like an aquarium, Blue Fox Aquarismo is constantly evolving. New content, tools and improvements are developed continuously, always focused on quality, responsibility and practical value.
ABOUT.COMMUNITY_P2: If you believe fishkeeping should be done with study, dedication and respect for the ecosystem, this space is yours too. Suggestions, experiences and contributions are always welcome. Blue Fox Aquarismo is not just a website: it is a project built to grow together with the community and strengthen responsible fishkeeping.

CONTACT.TITLE: Contact and corrections
CONTACT.LEAD: All Blue Fox Aquarismo content is reviewed, but something can always slip through. If you found wrong or outdated information, let us know: every report is read and, when it is correct, the page is fixed.
CONTACT.STEP1: On any article, use the Report an error button at the end of the page: the article is sent along with it.
CONTACT.STEP2: Or use the form below and tell us which page has the problem.
CONTACT.STEP3: If you can, include the correction and a source (link or reference). It speeds up the review.
